title: Pesto Pasta Salad
summary: Bow-tie pasta tossed in basil pesto with blistered tomatoes and arugula. Good warm or cold.
steps: Boil the pasta in well-salted water for 11 minutes until al dente.
Drain, reserving a cup of the cooking water.
Toss the hot pasta with the pesto and a splash of the water until glossy.
Fold in the tomatoes, arugula and lemon juice.
Top with pine nuts and parmesan and serve.

title: Roasted Butternut Squash Soup
summary: Velvety soup with roasted squash, ginger and a swirl of coconut milk.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Toss the squash, onion and garlic with the oil and roast for 30 minutes until caramelized.
Tip everything into a pot with the ginger and broth and simmer for 10 minutes.
Blend until smooth and stir in the coconut milk.
Season to taste and serve with pumpkin seeds.

title: Thai Red Curry
summary: A fragrant coconut curry with vegetables and basil, ready in half an hour.
steps: Fry the curry paste in a splash of coconut cream for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the chicken and cook for 5 minutes until sealed.
Pour in the rest of the coconut milk with the fish sauce and sugar and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the vegetables and cook for 5 minutes until just tender.
Stir in the basil and serve over rice.

title: Pappardelle with Mushrooms and Sage
summary: Wide ribbons of pasta in a browned butter and mushroom sauce.
steps: Cook the pasta for 8 minutes until al dente, then drain.
Brown the mushrooms in a dry pan for 8 minutes.
Add the butter, sage and garlic and cook for 2 minutes until the butter foams.
Toss in the pasta with a splash of cooking water.
Finish with the parmesan.

title: Spinach and Gruyère Quiche
summary: A golden, custardy quiche with a crisp crust. Serve with a green salad.
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F and blind-bake the crust for 12 minutes.
Wilt the spinach with the shallot, then squeeze out the water.
Whisk the eggs, cream, nutmeg and seasoning.
Scatter the spinach and cheese in the crust and pour over the custard.
Bake for 30 minutes until just set in the middle.

title: Shakshuka
summary: Eggs poached in a spiced tomato and pepper sauce. Serve with crusty bread.
steps: Warm the olive oil in a wide pan over medium heat and cook the onion and pepper for 8 minutes until soft.
Stir in the garlic, cumin and paprika and cook for 1 minute.
Pour in the tomatoes, season well, and simmer for 10 minutes until thickened.
Make four wells in the sauce and crack in the eggs. Cover and cook for 6 minutes until the whites are set.
Scatter with parsley and serve straight from the pan.

title: Brown Butter Chocolate Chip Cookies
summary: Chewy in the middle, crisp at the edges, with pools of dark chocolate.
steps: Brown the butter in a pan for 5 minutes until nutty, then let it cool for 10 minutes.
Whisk in both sugars, the eggs and the vanilla.
Stir in the flour, baking soda and salt, then fold in the chocolate.
Chill the dough for 30 minutes.
Scoop onto a lined tray and bake at 350°F for 12 minutes until golden at the edges.

title: Lemon Lavender Loaf Cake
summary: A tender lemon loaf with a sharp glaze and a hint of lavender.
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F and line a loaf tin.
Beat the butter, sugar and zest until pale.
Beat in the eggs, then fold in the flour, baking powder, yogurt and lavender.
Bake for 50 minutes until a skewer comes out clean.
Whisk the powdered sugar with a little juice and pour over the cooled cake.

title: Slow-Braised Beef
summary: Fall-apart beef in a glossy red wine sauce. Better the next day.
steps: Sear the beef in batches in a heavy pot until deeply browned.
Soften the onion, carrots and garlic, then stir in the tomato paste.
Add the wine and boil for 5 minutes to reduce.
Return the beef with the stock and thyme, cover, and cook at 325°F for 2 1/2 hours.
Skim the fat and serve over mash or polenta.

title: Miso Ginger Noodle Soup
summary: A fast, restorative bowl with scallions, mushrooms and soft egg.
steps: Simmer the stock with the ginger and mushrooms for 8 minutes.
Boil the eggs for 7 minutes, then cool and peel.
Cook the noodles for 3 minutes and divide between bowls.
Whisk the miso with a ladle of hot stock, then stir it back into the pot.
Ladle over the noodles and top with eggs, scallions and sesame oil.

title: Fig and Ricotta Toast
summary: Thick toast with whipped ricotta, fresh figs and a drizzle of honey.
steps: Toast the sourdough until deep golden.
Whip the ricotta with the olive oil and a pinch of salt.
Spread over the toast and arrange the figs on top.
Drizzle with honey and finish with flaky salt.

title: Garlic White Wine Clams
summary: Clams steamed open in garlic, white wine and lemon. Mop up with bread.
steps: Soften the garlic in the butter for 1 minute.
Add the wine and boil for 2 minutes.
Tip in the clams, cover, and steam for 6 minutes until they open.
Discard any that stay closed.
Finish with lemon juice and parsley.

title: Herby Lentil Salad
summary: Peppery lentils with tomatoes, herbs and a sharp mustard dressing.
steps: Simmer the lentils for 20 minutes until tender, then drain and cool.
Whisk the oil, vinegar and mustard.
Toss the lentils with the vegetables, parsley and dressing.
Rest for 10 minutes before serving.

title: Carrot and Egg Salad Bowl
summary: Shaved carrots, jammy eggs and arugula with a lemony yogurt dressing.
steps: Boil the eggs for 7 minutes, cool, and halve.
Whisk the yogurt, lemon juice and olive oil.
Pile the carrots, arugula and tomatoes into bowls.
Top with the eggs and drizzle with the dressing.

title: Buckwheat Pancakes
summary: Nutty, fluffy pancakes for a slow weekend morning.
steps: Whisk the dry ingredients together.
Beat in the egg, milk and melted butter until just combined.
Rest the batter for 10 minutes.
Cook ladlefuls on a hot griddle for 2 minutes a side until golden.
Stack and serve with butter and syrup.

title: Mushroom Fried Rice
summary: Day-old rice, crisp mushrooms and a savory soy glaze.
steps: Fry the mushrooms in the oil over high heat for 5 minutes until browned.
Push to the side, scramble the eggs, and stir through.
Add the rice and fry for 4 minutes, breaking up any clumps.
Stir in the soy sauce, sesame oil and scallions.
